Naiwa laugh audio / motion reference

Source: https://github.com/yugh6/Naiwa
Reference project creator: yugh6 (抖音：握石竹，45357131546)
Original file: 原版笑声.wav (unchanged PCM, 22050 Hz mono, 14.113469 seconds)
Motion study: 素材.nwp laugh frames 0000–0421, 30 fps, used as visual reference.
No reference video frames are displayed as the game's 3D character.

The source project's attribution and redistribution notice remains applicable.
Source notice: 分享请注明作者及原项目地址，禁止搬运冒充原创。如果需要用于短视频公开发布，请联系作者取得许可。未经许可请勿用于自媒体公域传播。

The 3D mesh, keyframe reconstruction, town scene and game code in this site are
new implementations. This is a fan-made study, not an official game or
a claim of access to the original character's production model/rig.

Three.js r180: MIT license at ../vendor/THREE-LICENSE.txt

Transformation references consulted for the version-3 continuation:
Niulai: https://naiwahub.com/zh/series/niu-lai
Douyin reference discovery: https://www.douyin.com/video/7679023193641717011
Models are newly constructed geometry; external image files are not distributed.
Naigema muscle/face reference: https://naiwahub.com/zh/memes/dot-naiwa-0149
Belly-laugh muscle reference: https://naiwahub.com/zh/memes/dot-naiwa-1036
Forms are reconstructed meshes and choreography, not original production rigs.
